data.one_liner: A lightweight widget that inverts the colors of its children.
data.what_it_does: Provides a single-purpose widget called InvertColors that wraps around any standard Flutter widget to invert its colors. It can be placed around entire pages, scaffolds, or specific subcomponents.
use_when: You need to quickly invert the colors of a specific widget or entire screen layout
You are looking for a lightweight color-inversion solution
avoid_when: You need complex theme switching or standard dark mode support
You require advanced color manipulation algorithms beyond simple inversion
strengths: Very lightweight and simple to use
weaknesses: Limited feature set beyond basic color inversion
Not documented with extensive configuration options
